story: The first stage of the Baloise Belgium Tour 2026 featured an early breakaway of four riders with a peak lead of 2:30. After the peloton accelerated, the break was caught and a second group of four competed fiercely for the golden kilometre. Rune Herregodts launched a late solo attempt but was reeled in by XDS Astana. Biniam Girmay won the sprint ahead of favorite Merlier, who finished second.
